title: Implement pack install action from MarketplaceBrowser
description:
PacksPage Marketplace tab delegates to MarketplaceBrowser component. Verify it shows available packs and has a working install action.

**Implementation:**
- Read `dashboard/src/components/packs/MarketplaceBrowser.tsx` to assess current state
- If stubbed: build a grid of available packs fetched from `GET /api/v1/packs/marketplace` (or registry endpoint)
- Each pack card shows: name, description, version, capabilities, install button
- Install button calls `POST /api/v1/packs` mutation
- On success: invalidate packs query and switch to Installed tab
- Add search/filter input for pack name

**Files:** `dashboard/src/components/packs/MarketplaceBrowser.tsx`, `dashboard/src/hooks/usePacks.ts`

implementationPlan.description: Verify MarketplaceBrowser.tsx already has useMarketplacePacks(), useInstallPack(), usePacks() for installed detection, search filter, and install action. All DoD items satisfied by existing code.
